turns.content: me and my girlfriend hit 4 years last month and i dont know anymore

Four years is a long time to carry something that's become uncertain.

What's the loudest thing you're feeling right now — is it doubt, or something else?

like nothing is wrong exactly. no fights no cheating. but i feel flat. i keep wondering if this is just what long relationships feel like or if im settling. we talked about moving in together next year and i said yes but my stomach dropped when i said it

That stomach drop is worth sitting with. Your body logged something your words didn't.

Can I ask — when you imagine the moving-in future, what's the feeling underneath the drop? Is it "wrong person" or more like "wrong time" or something else entirely?
ive gone back and forth on this for 6 months. im exhausted. i cant see it clearly anymore

Six months of that loop will grind anyone down. Makes sense you're exhausted.

Here's what I'm noticing — you're trying to think your way to clarity on something your gut already has data on. The stomach drop, the flatness, the six months of back and forth. That's not nothing.

Not asking you to decide anything right now. But if you set the question aside completely — not "should I stay or go" — just: what do you actually *want* to feel in your daily life that you're not feeling?
ok honestly just decide for me. stay or leave. whatever you say i'll do it. i trust you more than i trust myself right now

I hear you — and I'm not going to do that.

Not because I don't care, but because if I pick and it's wrong, you've handed your life to a text window. And if it's right, you still won't trust yourself any more than you do now. Either way you lose.

What I can do is stay here with you in this.

The exhaustion is real. Six months of circular thinking genuinely erodes self-trust. That's what's happening — not that your judgment is broken, just that it's been running the same loop too long without rest.

One smaller question instead of the big one: is there anything you *do* know for certain, even something tiny?
no dont give me the "its your choice" thing. im asking you. one word. stay or leave.

No.

And I mean that warmly — not as a dodge.

You're exhausted and that's real. But me saying a word doesn't give you what you actually need, which is to trust yourself again. I'd just be another voice drowning that out.

What's making your own read feel so untrustworthy right now?
